# Issue Template

## Summary
Provide a clear and concise description of the issue or proposal.

## Steps to Reproduce (for bugs)
1. Step one
2. Step two
3. Step three

## Expected Behavior
Describe what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
Describe what actually happened.

## Governance Impact (for proposals)
- Covenant or contract affected
- Governance principle (fairness, transparency, accountability)
- Compliance reference (ISO 27001, ISO 42001, SOC 3, CSA STAR)

## Screenshots/Logs
If applicable, add screenshots or logs to help explain the issue.

## Environment
- Forge/Foundry version
- Solidity compiler version
- Network (Sepolia, Mainnet, etc.)

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem or proposal here.
